column1: # Note on `littlefs` partition SubType: ESP-IDF's partition table format does
# NOT define a `littlefs` subtype — community convention (and what
# `esp_vfs_littlefs_register` expects) is to use `subtype=spiffs` for any
# data partition whose filesystem is selected at mount time by the registering
# code.  The partition label "littlefs" + the SubType "spiffs" together tell
# this partition and mount LittleFS on it.  See sfx_storage/README.md.
